scene_desc: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is showing Ross, Rachel, Joey, and Phoebe his engagement ring again.
Monica’s entrance makes Phoebe try to hide the ring by putting it in her mouth.
Central Perk, Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey are there as Rachel enters.
Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is practicing proposing.
The Charity Event, they’re holding a silent auction, Rachel is looking at one of the items and Phoebe walks up and hands her a glass of wine.
Rachel’s boss, Mr. Thompson walks up.
Elizabeth’s Dorm Room, Ross is walking up to her door and knocks on it. Suddenly the door opens and Elizabeth drags him into the room.
They start lobbing the balloons in. Ross desperately tries to get out of the line of fire but is struck in the back. The girls all retreat to relative safety behind the couch.
Both opposing camps start screaming at each other to drop their weapons and surrender. Finally, Ross steps in as a mediator.
The Charity Event, Mr. Thompson is announcing the winners of the silent auction.
Phoebe returns a with a tray full of different kinds of drinks.
Everyone applauds and he stands up slowly.

A Restaurant, Monica and Chandler are sitting at a table. Monica is checking her makeup as Chandler suddenly has a horrifying thought and starts patting down his pockets until he finds what he’s looking for and sighs in relief.

As he’s talking Monica notices someone familiar has just entered the restaurant. Let’s see; I seem to remember him driving a Ferrari in Hawaii solving crimes as a private investigator and as a certain eye doctor in more recent times.
Monica smiles then acts shocked. Chandler can’t believe she just did that.
